title: Senior Geotechnical Engineer
summary: Lead ground investigation programmes and foundation strategy on multidisciplinary projects.
responsibilities: Plan and supervise site investigation programmes
Develop ground models and interpretive reports
Design shallow and deep foundation solutions
requirements: Strong grounding in soil mechanics and foundation design

title: Structural Engineer
summary: Design efficient, buildable structures across concrete, steel and timber from concept to completion.
responsibilities: Produce scheme and detailed structural designs
Carry out analysis and prepare calculations
Coordinate with geotechnical and architectural teams

title: Graduate Engineer (Geotechnical/Structural)
summary: Join our structured graduate programme with rotations across geotechnical and structural teams.
responsibilities: Assist with site work and reporting
Contribute to a shared ground-to-frame model
requirements: Recent or expected degree in a relevant engineering discipline
Curiosity about both ground and structure
